item.tib: gnas mchog brag dkar bya rgod kyi yon tan gsal byed sgron me 'od 'bar
item.coloph: ces gnas mchog brag dkar bya rgod dkar chags (chag)gsal byed sgron me 'od 'bar zhes bya ba 'di/ skyabs mgon rin po che spral sku dza ya sam tri ta'i zhal snga nas/ gnas 'di'i dkar chags (chag)sngar grub thob rgyal ba lags kyi bka' 'di la brten nas rmongs pas go bde ba zhig sgrigs gsungs tshe thos chung mu la wer zhis shing bya'i lo hor zla drug pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa la gnas kyi zhal mdun gnyan shing nor bu rdzong du legs par bsdebs pa'o//
